producer_report.summary: Drain's "target met" now needs two things. First, a landing whose changed paths include studies/, the site generator or the page sources. Second, a model-backed source check of every page text file against the pinned source. The existing model.json self-consistency check stays as a floor. The source check is budget-guarded and its cost is added to spent_usd. Decision, CHANGELOG, README, module docs and `--help` state both rules. This resend only re-verified the work. The edits from the first attempt are unchanged, and the full test run passes.

checks_run.note: Ran as `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -q`. Every test binary reports 0 failed.

criteria_check.criterion: With a stubbed Steps, a drain whose only landing changed paths outside studies/, the site generator and the page sources, with the rating at the target, does not stop as "target met". The report says the landing did not change the outcome. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test `a_landing_outside_the_explainers_sources_cannot_meet_the_target_even_at_the_rating` in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs covers this. The full suite passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A landing that changes a study file or the site generator, then a rating at the target and a passing source check, still stops as "target met". Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: The tests `a_later_landing_that_changes_a_study_meets_the_target_after_an_unrelated_one`, `the_site_generator_is_an_outcome_changing_path` and `a_rating_at_the_target_stops_drain_only_with_a_passing_source_check` cover this. They pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Tests inject one wrong statement into each of claims.json, the intro, the transition and a glossary entry (for example teardown closes instead of can reopen; yolo-on allows self-merge; wrong handoff frees a place), plus one omitted fact. With a fake agent and stub pinner, RealSteps::check_page fails each time and names the statement, and drain does not report "target met". Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: `a_wrong_statement_in_any_page_text_input_fails_the_check_and_is_named` in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs injects each wrong statement and the omitted fact. It uses `SourceJudge`, a fake agent, and a stub pinner. It passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A code check and test fail if any text-bearing file in a study directory is not covered by the source check. A page with correct text in every file passes. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: The tests `a_file_the_checker_did_not_read_fails_the_check`, `a_text_file_added_to_a_study_is_checked_without_anyone_listing_it`, `every_file_of_the_shipped_study_is_page_text_except_the_two_structural_ones` and `a_page_with_correct_text_in_every_file_passes_the_source_check_with_one_verifier_call` cover this. All pass.

criteria_check.criterion: The source check is budget-guarded: the reserve covers every model call it will make (one per study or a single call), drain stops as "budget spent" when it does not fit, and the cost is added to spent_usd. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: The tests `the_source_check_runs_only_when_its_whole_cap_fits_and_otherwise_drain_stops_as_budget_spent`, `what_the_source_check_costs_is_added_to_the_spend_even_when_it_fails` and `the_reserve_for_the_source_check_grows_with_the_number_of_studies` cover this. They pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Stop::TargetMet docs, module docs, `athena drain --help`, a new decision in docs/decisions.md (with alternatives, covering all page text, and the self-consistency floor) and CHANGELOG.md state both rules.
criteria_check.evidence: The edits are in drain.rs, main.rs, display.rs, docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md and README.md. `drain_help_documents_the_flags_and_lists_every_stop_reason` passes.
`cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` all passed in this session.

open_issues: athena.toml was not modified. The reading lists it as allowed, but nothing needed changing there.
mistakes: The first attempt's criteria_check apparently did not report every criterion as met. This resend re-verified each one with evidence.
learnings: Bash policy blocks grep and pipes, so test summaries need `cargo test -q`. Tool-result files outside the working directory cannot be read.
desires: Read access to the saved tool-output files, which would have saved the extra quiet test run.
